results.title: Ranabaali
results.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

results.title: DNK
results.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

results.title: The Paradise
results.overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

results.title: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
results.overview: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

results.title: Irumudi
results.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

results.title: Comrade Kalyan
results.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

results.title: Thella Kaagitham
results.overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

results.title: Itllu Arjuna
results.overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

results.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
results.overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

results.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
results.overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

results.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
results.overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

results.title: ENE Repeat
results.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

results.title: Happy Journey
results.overview: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

results.title: Naa Wife Missing
results.overview: A newly married couple's happy life takes a mysterious turn when the wife suddenly disappears. As the husband seeks help, doubts about her past and hidden secrets begin to surface.

results.title: Epic - First Semester
results.overview: Far from home, Aditya wrestles with family expectations, cultural differences and loneliness while studying in London – until he meets the lively Kadali.

results.title: Anakapalli
results.overview: In rural Anakapalli, a young man enters the criminal underworld under a feared gangster. When love arrives, he faces a choice between power, loyalty, and his former dreams in this tale of action and destiny.

results.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
results.overview: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

results.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
results.overview: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

results.title: Crazy Kalyanam
results.overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

results.title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
results.overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.
